[SWS_SM_00608] ActionListItem - Function Group State
Upstream requirements:
RS_SM_00001, RS_SM_00005
⌈
When a Function Group State
ActionListItem
is found in the
ActionLists
,
StateMachine
shall request the configured
Function Group State
from
Exe-
cution Management
.
⌋
To enable
State Management
to build a
Function Group
dependency the
Ac-
tionListItems
shall be executed in the order they are configured.
